headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: GHMC demolishes 3 illegal constructions in Hyderabad in one day.
Dy CM has sought Rohith Vemula Telangana Bill draft in 3 months.
Opposition parties plan ‘Chalo Raj Bhavan’ protest in Vijayawada on October 10.
El Nino rains flood South America, sending residents fleeing and cattle swimming.
bullets_ur: GHMC ne Hyderabad mein aik din mein 3 ghair qanooni tameeraat munhadam kar deen.
Dy CM ne Rohith Vemula ke Telangana Bill ka draft 3 maheenay mein maang liya.
Mukhalif jamaaton ne 10 October ko Vijayawada mein 'Chalo Raj Bhavan' ehtijaj ka mansooba banaya hai.
El Nino ki barishon se South America mein sailab, shehri bhagnay par majboor aur maweshi tairnay lagay
